reasoning_details.text:
This prefix asks about trying a hotbox with something added — the continuation jokes about adding peppers that knock the wind out of you, with friends refusing to repeat the experiment after trying it once. It's a plausible, coherent completion playing on the pepper-smoke angle.

Option B instead reads hotbox as a lamb dish, describing roasting, cheese, and spices as "nirvana in the mouth" — grammatically fine but more generic and food-cliché. I'm leaning toward A since its joke about friends declining a repeat feels more specific and concrete than B's vague sensory description.
